description: Teaching model of the Korean insurance solvency ratio K-ICS: basic required capital = √(Σ ρij·Ri·Rj) over life/long-term, general non-life, market and credit risk (illustrative Solvency II-like correlations), plus operational risk minus tax adjustment; ratio = available capital ÷ required capital, with prompt corrective action bands (100% / 50% / 0%). Not the supervisory calculation.
